mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals monetary easing, reducing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and increasing equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days during easing cycles.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) increase above 4.0% signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending power and corporate earnings growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances with UNRATE > 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates supply-demand mismatch with supply constraints outpacing demand, triggering inflationary pressures and tighter monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decline and RSAFS rise from prior month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances with INDPRO decline and RSAFS rise, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 5.0%), a federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increase signals aggressive monetary tightening, raising discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances with CPIAUCSL > 5.0% and FEDFUNDS increase, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1,400.0 thousand units signals strong consumer demand for goods and services, boosting corporate revenue growth expectations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances with HOUST > 1400.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust household consumption, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days during stable inflation.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances with rising RSAFS, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) falling below 150,000 thousand signals labor market contraction, reducing consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances with PAYEMS < 150000.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) declining below 100.0 (index) indicates manufacturing contraction, signaling economic slowdown and reduced corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances with INDPRO < 100.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
